During Exercise
Drink 150 to 350 mL (6 to 12 oz) of fluid every 15 to 20 min, depending 
on race speed, environmental conditions, and tolerance; no more than 
1 C (8 to 10 oz) every 15 to 20 min, although individualized recom-
mendations must be followed.
After Exercise
Drink 25% to 50% more than existing weight loss to ensure hydration 4 
to 6 hours after exercise.
Drink 450 to 675 mL (16 to 24 oz) of fluid for every pound of body weight 
lost during exercise.
If an athlete is participating in multiple workouts in 1 day, then 80% of 
fluid loss must be replaced before the next workout.
Electrolyte Replacement
Sodium: 0.5 to 0.7 g/L in activity longer than 1 hour to enhance palat-
ability and the drive to drink, to reduce the risk of hyponatremia and 
to minimize risk of muscle cramps.
